name: recall-working-report
title: Recall working report. Draft for operator review.
for_each: select id,code from recalls order by code

sections.title: Distribution contacts
sections.sql: select lot,destination,business,contact,phone,address from distribution_contacts where recall_id=$1 order by lot,destination

sections.title: Reconciliation
sections.note: Unaccounted quantities remain unresolved. Consumed is not recovered. Quantities stay separated by product and unit.
sections.sql: select lot,destination,unit,distributed,returned,destroyed,consumed,unaccounted from recovery_balance where recall_id=$1 order by lot,destination

sections.title: On-site stock
sections.sql: select b.lot,b.unit,b.quantity,b.held,b.samples,b.distributed,b.undistributed from lot_balance b join recall_lots x on x.lot_id=b.id where x.recall_id=$1

sections.title: Recorded communications
sections.sql: select c.kind,c.occurred_at,c.method,c.reference,c.actor from communications c join recipients x on x.id=c.recipient_id where x.recall_id=$1 order by c.occurred_at

sections.title: Report evidence
sections.sql: select kind,reference,recorded_on,actor from reports where recall_id=$1 order by recorded_on

sections.title: Contact verification evidence
sections.sql: select lot,destination,verification_reference from distribution_contacts where recall_id=$1 and verification_reference is not null order by lot,destination

name: distribution-list
title: Recall distribution list. Draft.
for_each: select id,code from recalls order by code

sections.title: Direct recipients
sections.note: Verify recipients, contact evidence and scope before using the jurisdiction-specific regulator template. Nothing is sent.
sections.sql: select lot,destination,business,contact,phone,address from distribution_contacts where recall_id=$1 order by lot,destination

sections.title: Supplied quantities
sections.sql: select lot,destination,quantity,unit from distribution_contacts where recall_id=$1 order by lot,destination
